title: The 3 Best Packing Cubes Under $20
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for packing cubes under $20, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at packing cubes under $20 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: TravelWise Packing Cube System 5 Piece Weekender Plus Set
products.blurb: Key specs: 5 cubes: 1 small, 2 medium, 2 large, Mesh top panel on each cube, 2-way pull zippers.
strengths: 5 cubes at this price is close to the lowest per-piece cost available
2 medium plus 2 large sizes cover a week of clothing for one traveler
Mesh tops and working 2-way zippers, the core features, are present despite the low price
limitations: Fabric and zippers are noticeably thinner than premium ripstop sets
Fewer color options than pricier competitors
features: Mesh top panel on each cube
Frequently priced near or under $20 for the set

products.name: Gonex Compression Packing Cubes 10 Set
products.blurb: Key specs: 10-piece set: 1 XL, 2 large, 2 medium cubes plus specialty bags, Double zipper compression, Honeycomb ripstop fabric.
strengths: Only compression option that regularly comes close to this price range
10 pieces, including a shoe and laundry bag, at a very low per-piece cost when on sale
Honeycomb ripstop resists tearing better than plain thin nylon
limitations: Compression zippers wear faster than the main zippers under heavy use
10 loose pieces means more to track for a simple, quick trip
features: 10-piece set: 1 XL, 2 large, 2 medium cubes plus specialty bags
Typically priced $30 to $35 for 10 pieces, often on sale nearer $20 to $25

products.name: eBags Classic 4 Piece Packing Cube Set
products.blurb: Key specs: 4 cubes: large, medium, small, and slim, TechLite diamond nylon, YKK zippers.
strengths: Lifetime warranty adds long-term value even at a slightly higher price
4 distinct sizes cover more item types than a basic 3-piece budget set
limitations: Requires waiting for a sale to fit this specific budget tier
features: 4 cubes: large, medium, small, and slim
Usually priced above $20, occasionally on sale near it

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
